I haven't changed anything yet. I found a likely fix, but I can't verify it in this session, and the fix touches many test expectations.

**Blocker:** the Bash tool was denied ("don't ask mode"), so I can't run `acdc-test`, `acdc-typecheck`, or `acdc-lint`. I haven't tried to route around that.

**Likely cause:** `generateNodesGraph` in `packages/workflow/src/telemetry-helpers.ts` sends every node's canvas `position` (`[x, y]`, around line 244), and every sticky note's `position`, `height`, and `width` (around line 231). Canvas coordinates are cosmetic. The only thing that uses them is the note-overlap check, which runs locally on the raw workflow before the payload is built, so the payload doesn't need them.

**Planned change if you approve:**
1. `packages/workflow/src/interfaces.ts`: drop `position` from `INodeGraphItem` (around line 3036) and `INoteGraphItem` (around line 3018).
2. `packages/workflow/src/telemetry-helpers.ts`: drop `position: node.position` from the node item (around line 244) and `position: topLeft` from the note item (around line 231). Keep `stickyNote.position` for the overlap calculation.
3. `packages/workflow/test/telemetry-helpers.test.ts`: remove `position` from the expected output objects. About 50 `position` lines in that file are expected-output entries; the rest are inputs and stay. I'd have to edit these one by one with Edit, because the same `position: [..]` strings repeat, so this is laborious and easy to get wrong without running the tests.

**Open questions for you:**
- Is `position` the value you meant? Other candidates are `workflow_id`, `src_node_id`/`src_instance_id`, and the node `id` UUID. I can switch if one of those is the intended target.
- Can you re-enable Bash (or run `acdc-test packages/workflow/test/telemetry-helpers.test.ts`, `acdc-typecheck`, and `acdc-lint` yourself afterwards)? I'd rather not push an unverified diff across that many test lines.
